small_guidance: Reduce autotune search space to 2-3 safe configs (e.g. BLOCK_OC=32/BLOCK_SP=64 num_warps=4 stages=2) to avoid long compile/tuning sweeps that hit the 1800s timeout. Also drop tl.static_range over IC=16 with KD*KH*KW=27 unrolling — collapse the IC loop to a regular range or a tl.dot over a tiled K dimension to cut compile time drastically.
large_guidance: Rewrite as an im2col-style GEMM where K = IC*KD*KH*KW is tiled with tl.dot: one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), gather x with stride-aware index math (id_num%SD==0 mask), and accumulate via tl.dot(W_tile, X_tile). Fold BatchNorm (eval-time scale/shift from running stats) and the spatial-mean subtraction into the conv epilogue using a two-pass scheme: first kernel writes conv+BN and accumulates per-(n,oc) sum; second small kernel subtracts mean. This avoids the massive static unroll causing the compile timeout.
